messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "this applies even if only take metoprolol for blood pressure"
set: ["this applies even if only take metoprolol for blood pressure", "continue use for high blood pressure even if feeling fine", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "keep taking even when feeling fine if being treated for high blood pressure", "do this even if you feel well", "continue use even if feeling well when treating high blood pressure", "monitor for blood pressure changes", "even if blood sugar is normal", "keep using even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "take only if doctor tells you to", "keep appointments for blood tests even if feeling completely well", "do this even if you are feeling well", "this applies to most brands of levothyroxine", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well", "this is true even if you have no symptoms", "following applies"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "continue use for high blood pressure even if feeling fine",
    "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure",
    "keep taking even when feeling fine if being treated for high blood pressure",
    "continue use even if feeling well when treating high blood pressure",
    "do this even if you feel well",
    "do this even if you are feeling well",
    "keep using even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure",
    "keep using this medicine even if you feel well",
    "this is true even if you have no symptoms"
  ],
  "alias": "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure"
}
